body: In a galvanic cell the anode is the negative electrode and the cathode is the positive electrode; in an electrolytic cell the anode is positive and the cathode is negative.

title: Anode and cathode
body: In every electrochemical cell, galvanic or electrolytic, oxidation occurs at the anode and reduction occurs at the cathode.
